messages:
Devon: FYI I see a regression in TP all-reduce latency after the kernel-selection change on prod-4xA100. seq_len=1536 workloads spike ~18% p50.
Maria: Can you paste the perf summary / flamegraph?
Devon: Posted below. Quick summary: ring algorithm dominates, but for small-ish chunks (~32-128KB) we get bad serialization. nvlink links show one GPU waiting ~40ms.
Lee: paste of `nvprof` snippet:
```
# nccl_allreduce: 32KB chunks
GPU0 waiting time: 41.2ms
GPU1 wait: 39.8ms
PCIe TX: 0.8ms
Avg comm: 15ms
```
Sam: This smells like message fragmentation + kernel-selection forcing ring for all sizes. We changed selection to prefer ring for throughput a couple of commits ago (commit 5f8a2e9).
infra-bot: perf-dashboard: https://perf.redwood/internal/bench/1773509123 (snapshot attached)
Maria: The flamegraph indicates gap during prepare_kv_cache stage then long allreduce tail. Could KV cache misses be inflating message sizes unpredictably?
Devon: Yes — when kv cache hit rate drops, activation tensors are bigger and we end up with larger aggregated grads per slice, which flips the effective message-size distribution. The current heuristic uses static shard-size->ring mapping.
Lee: I ran microbench: tree algorithm outperforms ring at 64KB-256KB range for p50 on our topology. Ring wins for >1MB. So a hybrid is best.
Sam: Proposed change: implement dynamic selection in comm layer: use tree for msg_sz in [16KB,512KB], ring otherwise. Also add adaptive thresholds based on observed latency.
Devon: Patch prototype:
```
if (msg_sz >= TREE_MIN && msg_sz <= TREE_MAX) {
  ncclAlgo = NCCL_TREE;
} else {
  ncclAlgo = NCCL_RING;
}
```
Also add windowed sampling to avoid oscillation.
Maria: Another optimization: if KV cache hit -> skip allreduce for KV-only shards. i.e., tag gradients that only touch cached KV and bypass comm.
Lee: Agree, can short-circuit many layers in decoder-only models with high cache-hit.
Sam: We should be careful with correctness + numeric parity. Add smoke test that runs A/B with deterministic seeds across algorithms.
ci-bench-bot: queued job 5827: perf-ab-test/hybrid-tree-ring (4xA100, seq=1536, batch=8)
Devon: I'll sketch telemetry: collect msg_size histogram per op, per layer, and algorithm chosen. We need per-TP-rank traces so we can correlate wait times.
Maria: Also capture KV cache hit rate and prefix length.
Devon: Action items:
- Lee: run AB job and attach raw nvprof + nccl logs (assigned)
- Sam: prototype dynamic threshold config + sample window (assign)
- Maria: add KV-cache-tagging to optimizer commit (assign)
- I'll coordinate smoke tests and perf dashboard links

Devon: Anyone objections to landing experimental flag behind `runtime.tp.hybrid_allreduce=true`?
Sam: No objections. :+1:
Maria: +1
Lee: +1
infra-bot: created feature-flag `runtime.tp.hybrid_allreduce` (off by default)
Devon: Great. I'll open the PR with tests and perf baselines, cc-ing @eng-sre for canary rollout gating. :rocket:
